evidence.note: Fits a post-hoc sparse autoencoder to the frozen dense tensors that two vision-language agents exchange, finds a 128-fold payload reduction at near-identical reconstruction and roughly unchanged single-run accuracy, and then spends most of the paper enumerating the alternative explanations its own design cannot rule out.
evidence.title: Post-Hoc Sparse Coding of Latent Communication Between Vision-Language Model Agents

evidence.note: Replaces a verbose natural-language rationale with two to six executable action tokens drawn from a fixed vocabulary, supervised automatically by pairing logged trajectories with scene context, so that driving-oriented reasoning fits inside a real-time control budget that verbose chain-of-thought exceeds by three to four times.
evidence.title: XCoT-VLA: Executable Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Driving
